status: prototype trial; simulation, arithmetic and data-sheet limits only
circuit: Place a normally-off cascode between raw B+ and the CB-009 fixed feed:

M1.SOA: 75 W minimum: VDS 800 V, ID 94 mA, case 75 C, 5 s

U1.switching_condition: 200 pF, 20 mA; typical only, no maximum

Q1.note: Generic 2N3904 Gummel-Poon model. Saturation current swept x0.5 to x2.

RS.part: two 27.4 ohm 1 % 0.25 W thin-film in parallel
RS.note: One open leaves 27.4 ohm: the limit halves and the rail sags into the window trip.

DZ.connects: cathode M2 drain, anode M2 source

RG1.note: 10 k let a hard close pass 0.6 A for 4 to 14 us. 100 ohm cuts that to under 0.2 us.

RLED.note: 10.3 to 17.8 mA over the CB-007 4.07 to 5.48 V drive window.

findings: No AQV259H exists. The 5000 Vrms H types stop at AQV256H, 600 V.
Normal 22.72 mA uses 76 % of the 25 C connection-A rating before derating.
Maker caution "Continual DC bias (AQV259 and AQV258)": a steady input-to-output bias can degrade the output breakdown voltage. A high-side B+ switch has that bias.
Panasonic AQV259 as the series switch.source: Panasonic ASCTB465E 202601, PhotoMOS HE DIP6 1 Form A

IXTH12N100L / IXTK22N100L enhancement li.SOA_12N100L: 200 W: 800 V, 0.25 A, case 60 C (2007 preliminary sheet)
IXTH12N100L / IXTK22N100L enhancement li.finding: Electrically suitable with one photovoltaic driver only at the 5 V threshold limit (VOC minimum 7.8 V at 25 C). DigiKey Canada snapshot 28 Nov 2026: zero stock, 24 and 29 week lead. Unverified second-hand reading.

rejected.IXCP10M45S / IXCY10M45S two-terminal reg: Task statement: 450 V class. Below the 550 V cold case.
rejected.Energise-to-trip gate pull-down on M1: A depletion FET stays on when control power is lost.

stock.status: Distributor snapshots through web search on 28 Nov 2026. Second-hand and undated. Confirm on the distributor page before ordering.
stock.IXTP3N100D2: Mouser about 1,100 to 2,048 in two aggregator snapshots; DigiKey zero with 57 week lead.
stock.VOM1271T: DigiKey regional pages 94,039 and 103,415; LCSC 3,373; RS 110.
stock.NDT3055L: Not checked. Data sheet revised March 2025.

declared_assumptions: VOM1271 hot minimum: 4 uA and 6.0 V. Cold maximum: 40 uA and 9.5 V. The sheet gives 6 uA and 7.8 V minimum at 10 mA, 25 C only.
VOM1271 turn-off is a 150 k switch fitted to the 65 us typical at 200 pF. 470 k is the slow case.
M1 and M2 are level-1 surrogates with series drift resistance and fixed capacitances.
M1 drift resistance x2.3 hot. Q1 0 to 85 C. RS 1 %.
Raw B+ is a stiff source. Wiring inductance is absent.
off_state_note: Level-1 model has no drain leakage. Data sheet: 5 uA at 25 C, 50 uA at 125 C at 1000 V. DZ carries it; M2 then holds 10 V and M1 gate-source is -10 V of the 20 V rating.

fails_safe: LED, driver or VOM1271 dead: open
both RS open: under 4 mA through RB
one RS open: limit falls to 20 to 24 mA, the safe direction
guard_one_fault_reading.degrades_to_self_bias: Q1 open, M2 short or DZ short leave M1 self-biased on RS: 212 to 288 mA, below the 400 mA switch pulse rating. The 10 ms case is then lost. M2 or DZ short also loses the guard disconnect.
removes_guard: M1 drain-source or gate-source short. M2 and DZ then meet raw B+ and must be assumed shorted.
RS short (film resistors normally fail open)
LED driver stuck on removes only the disconnect
guard_one_fault_reading.with_guard_removed: CB-009 applies unchanged: AQV256HA 2 ms cutoff holds 342.45 V; 10 ms and weld cases fail.
guard_one_fault_reading.latent_fault_test: At each start hold the guard LED off for 100 ms after the series switch closes. Any rail rise above 60 V means a shorted guard. Refuse to arm.

commanded_open_at_normal_load.case: cold high, 1.5 M turn-off, ten times the typical

sequence_rule: Close the series AQV256HA first. Light the guard LED last. The driver then ramps the current.

cases.case: guard limiting, rail held at 295 V window edge, raw 445 V mean
same at the low guard limit
rail short, bypass closed, 2 ms trip, 440 V
rail short, 10 ms late trip, 550 V
cold-start rail short to the 1 s timeout, bypass welded, 550 V

heat.note: In the window-edge case the CB-009 pass device is in dropout. Heat moves from the pass device to M1. The CB-009 overload bound for the pass device was 5.0 W.

gate_drive_headroom.note: Recheck the CB-009 +5 V regulator heat with the added LED current.

self_bias_only.note: IXTP3N100D2 with only a source resistor. Limit is about |VGS(off)|/R. VGS(off) spans 2.5 to 4.5 V.
self_bias_only.verdict: No value gives more than 22.72 mA at the low end and under 63 mA at the high end with a small drop.

checks.hot_low_guard_load_margin: 18 mA holds 309.3 V; 20 mA sags; 22 mA fails. CB-009 alone held 22 mA at 306.4 V.
open_items: All reservoirs lost with a shorted pass still exceeds 350 V.
M1 short is a latent single fault. Use the start proof test or the two-device stack.
VOM1271 switching and hot output are typical or assumed. Measure them.
M1 needs a 5.6 K/W insulated path or the pass sink.
Bench: capture guard current, M2 gate and rail in a forced pass short.
